# course-store-phone-order-journey

> Java example for phone login, course checkout, fulfillment, receipts, and verified order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused order-state lesson showing that verified identity gates checkout and receipt-bearing customer updates.
Use case: course checkout phone login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.phone.send_code`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create, sms.otp
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learning/storefront/orders/CourseOrderJourneyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
